threatReview.publicOwnership: Registration email is never proof. Current-password setup plus mailbox confirmation is required; unknown/unverified/verified public requests have the same acknowledgement before lookup. Per-action client/shared budgets and bounded workers reduce spam/hash amplification; distributed abuse and account-targeted temporary denial remain residual risks for later infrastructure review.
threatReview.bearerProof: CSPRNG64hex secrets, digest-only database storage, account/password-hash/address binding, exact expiry and compare-and-set single consumer. Fragment scrub/private-page analytics guard and no persistent UI proof storage reduce incidental leakage; a stolen unexpired link remains sensitive, and email account security/provider compromise remain external dependencies.
threatReview.sessionAndSupport: Only proved/ambiguous writes revoke sessions; invalid token/read failure cannot kick an owner. Normal login after reset, no administrator BCC/password disclosure/ownership override. Protected durable roles and existing negative admin tests retain scope.
threatReview.operations: Configured provider startup validation, eight-second no-redirect HTTP bound, sanitized diagnostics, bounded shutdown-owned RAM queue, no auto-retry. Accepted messages may not arrive; queued unsent messages may be lost on restart and users must deliberately request again after cooldown. Human mailbox delivery, sender/stream eligibility and support handling remain operator checks.
